spans.s: आह्वय m. 1. A law-suit arising from a dispute about games with animals (Rāghavānanda on M.viii.7 says- आह्वयः पणपूर्वकपक्षिमेषादियोधनम्; 2. appellation, name, काव्यं रामायणाह्वयम् Ram.
आह्वाय m. 1. A summons; 2. a name.
आह्वा f. 1. Name, appellation; 2. calling, calling out.
आह्वान n. 1. A call or summons from government; 2. invocation of a deity; 3. challenge; 4. a call or invitation (in general), सुहृदाह्वानं प्रकुर्वीत Panch.iii.; 5. an appellation, a name.
आह्वायक m. A messenger, आहूयकेभ्यः श्रुतसूनुवृत्तिः Bt.ii.44, (where आहूयकेभ्यः occurs as a variant for आख्यायकेभ्यः).
